data.body:
Root cause evidence, read from the Windows sweep job logs of runs 43820680079, 43871224211 and the b4e0d01b649 scheduled run (2026-11-15/16). Every failure uses a POSIX-only API on Windows with no Windows path:

1. Product, gate admission: `src/rebar/llm/gate_admission.py:25-28` imports `fcntl` directly (flock at :244, :270) and disarms the concurrency cap when it is absent (:333-336, reason "advisory locking (fcntl) unavailable"). Both `test_gate_admission_09da.py` failures assert on that marker. The store already has a portable leg with a Windows `msvcrt.locking` branch, `rebar._store.lock_kernel` (`take_exclusive`/`release_exclusive`/`leg_name`, `src/rebar/_store/lock_kernel.py:111-156`).
2. Product, grounding harness: `run_in_worker` maps a crash to `parse_error` only for a negative exit code (`src/rebar/grounding/harness.py:385-395`). A native crash on Windows exits with a positive NTSTATUS code (e.g. 0xC0000005), so it would land in `other`. The payload `tests/unit/grounding/_worker_payloads.py:52-65` sends itself `signal.SIGKILL`, absent on Windows (worker "raised: AttributeError").
3. Collection: `tests/unit/test_bridge_runner_spawn.py:201` uses `-signal.SIGKILL` in a module-level parametrize; the collection error (`ERROR tests/unit/test_bridge_runner_spawn.py - AttributeError: module 'signal' has no attribute 'SIGKILL'`) is the only error in the logs of `test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_make_test_never_selects_a_live_test_even_with_jira_credentials_set` and `test_collection_isolation_guard.py::test_the_live_unit_tier_collects_clean`.
4. Test stub: `tests/unit/test_spawn_detached.py:83-87` swaps `_proc.subprocess` for a SimpleNamespace with only `Popen`/`DEVNULL`; on Windows `_proc._detach_kwargs` (`src/rebar/_proc.py:112-121`) reads `DETACHED_PROCESS` from it (4 tests); `:123-124` assert POSIX kwargs unconditionally.
5. POSIX-only legs exercised without a capability guard: fcntl-leg tests patching `_kernel.fcntl.flock` while it is None (`test_lock_stale_reclaim.py` 6, `test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py` 2); the fcntl control (`test_fcntl_import_guard.py`); `resource` reads (`test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py` 2; product already returns None without `resource`, `src/rebar/llm/peak_rss.py:40-48`); signal-killed children (`test_live_dc_pass_health.py` 2, `test_external_mutation_diagnostics.py` 1); in-process SIGTERM handler grace (`test_mcp_http_transport.py`, `assert 15 == 0`: on Windows `os.kill(pid, SIGTERM)` is TerminateProcess with exit 15, no handler runs); `os.getuid` (`tests/scripts/test_gerrit_object_store_repair.py:72,92`, which runs the Linux host script `infra/scripts/materialize-gerrit-jgit-config.sh` that chowns to uid:gid) and `os.geteuid` (`tests/unit/test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py:517`).
